register_acc_op_linear: register a linear operator mapping that wraps nn.functional.linear for accuracy tracing
map_transpose_to_permute: map torch.transpose calls to acc_ops.permute by computing the dimension shuffle
decompose_std_to_basic_ops: decompose torch.std into mean, sub, pow, and sqrt acc ops for tracing
map_quantized_linear_module: unpack a quantized Linear module into weight, bias, and quantized_linear acc op nodes
register_custom_mapper_for_addmm: map torch.addmm to matmul and add acc ops with optional mul for alpha and beta scaling
